beginner.summary: For data engineers, analysts and DBAs who completed a general Hadoop or SQL course and now want to work with Apache Hive itself. Covers running Hive 4 in Docker, the HiveServer2, Driver and Metastore query lifecycle, metastore schema and schematool, managed versus external tables, HiveQL types, loading, joins, grouping sets, window functions, lateral views, partitions, SerDes, ORC tables, Java UDFs, configuration layers, EXPLAIN plans, and a web log warehouse capstone.
prerequisites: Writes SQL joins, aggregates and subqueries against a relational database
Knows what HDFS, YARN and a file format are at the level of an introductory Hadoop course
Has a laptop with Docker Desktop or Docker Engine, 8 GB RAM free and a terminal
outcomes: Run Hive 4 locally and query it through Beeline using JDBC URLs, scripts and variables
Explain how HiveServer2, the Driver, the Metastore and the execution engine cooperate on one query
Write HiveQL with complex types, window functions, grouping sets, lateral views and partitioned ORC tables
Read EXPLAIN output and the HiveServer2 web UI to explain why a query is slow or wrong

Propagation of tags through lineage
Deny policies and exceptions ordering
Masking by tag across all tables
Ranger audit volume and retention in Solr, OpenSearch or HDFS
Hive hooks: hive.exec.post.hooks and the Atlas hook for lineage
Metastore event listeners for DDL audit
Auditing impersonation and doAs identities
Policy as code: export and import of Ranger JSON
Access review reports
days.lab_task: Tag the email columns of 10 tables with an Atlas classification PII via the REST API, create one tag-based Ranger policy that masks PII for group analysts, then query all 10 tables as an analyst. Export the policies as JSON and import into a second Ranger service, and build a report of denied accesses over 24 hours from the audit store.
days.deliverable: Tag script, one tag-based policy, exported JSON and a denied-access report
checks: Query email column on each of the 10 tagged tables as analyst
All 10 return masked values with no table-specific policy
Add a new table and tag its email column
The mask applies on the first query after the tag sync with no policy edit
Lists the denied events with user, resource and policy id
objectives: Apply tag-based masking across many tables
Capture audit and lineage with hooks
Manage Ranger policies as code

days.topic: Hive Upgrade Planning: 3.x to 4.x, Metastore Schema and Behaviour Changes
subtopics: Release notes review: removed and deprecated features
Metastore schema upgrade with schematool -upgradeSchema and a backup first
Behaviour changes in default table type and CBO
Configuration property diffs between versions
Rolling upgrade order: metastore, then HiveServer2, then LLAP
Client compatibility: Beeline JDBC driver and Spark metastore client
Regression test set from production queries
Rollback limits after a schema upgrade
Stakeholder communication and freeze windows
days.lab_task: Back up a lab metastore with pg_dump, take schematool -info output on the old version, run -upgradeSchema using the new distribution, and run a replay of 25 saved queries on old and new versions. Diff row counts and EXPLAIN plans, list every changed hive-site.xml default using SET -v from both, and restore the pg_dump to rehearse rollback.
days.deliverable: Upgrade runbook, schema before and after, query diff report and rollback rehearsal notes
checks: Metastore schema version equals the new distribution's version
Row counts match on all 25 or each difference is documented with a cause
pg_restore of the backup and schematool -info
Schema version returns to the original value
objectives: Plan an upgrade with backups and tested rollback
Run schema upgrades and configuration diffs
Prove behaviour parity with a query replay

days.topic: Benchmarking with TPC-DS and Performance Regression Gates
subtopics: TPC-DS data generation at a chosen scale factor
Loading text then ORC or Iceberg
Running the 99 queries with timing capture
Stable benchmark rules: warm-up, three runs and median
Comparing engines on identical hardware
Statistics collection before benchmark runs
Regression thresholds in CI
Storing results in a table for trend analysis
Common benchmark mistakes: caching, stale stats, different data layouts
days.lab_task: Generate TPC-DS at scale factor 10, load into ORC with ANALYZE ... FOR COLUMNS, run all 99 queries 3 times each through a Python wrapper using beeline --outputformat=csv2, and store median time per query in a results table. Repeat after changing one setting such as LLAP on, and write a gate that fails when any query regresses over 20 percent.
days.deliverable: Benchmark scripts, results table and a regression gate script with a sample pass and fail
checks: Exits 0 with no query above the 20 percent threshold
Exits non-zero and lists the regressed queries
objectives: Run a repeatable TPC-DS benchmark on Hive
Store medians and compare configurations
Automate regression gates

days.topic: Incident Response Playbooks for HiveServer2, Metastore and Tez
subtopics: HiveServer2 hangs: thread dumps with jstack and open session counts
Metastore database connection exhaustion
Slow partition listing and metastore timeouts
HiveServer2 OutOfMemoryError from large result sets and many partitions
Stuck Tez sessions and orphaned YARN applications
ZooKeeper session loss and HA flapping
Lock pile-ups: SHOW LOCKS and the HIVE_LOCKS table
Triage order, communication and post-incident reviews
Alerts from JMX metrics: open sessions, queries active, GC pauses
days.lab_task: Reproduce three faults in a lab: an HS2 heap exhaustion from SELECT * on a 100,000-partition table, metastore DB connection exhaustion by lowering the pool, and a lock pile-up from a stuck transaction. For each, record symptoms, the log lines, commands used to diagnose (jstack, jcmd GC.heap_info, SHOW LOCKS), the fix and a Prometheus alert expression.
days.deliverable: Three incident playbooks with symptoms, diagnostic commands, fixes and alert rules
checks: Log shows java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space and jcmd output shows old gen full
Client errors report failing to obtain a connection and the fix raises the pool size or reduces concurrency
SHOW LOCKS lists waiting locks behind one long transaction and aborting it clears them
objectives: Diagnose HiveServer2 and metastore faults with standard tools
Write fix and alert steps for each fault
Run a post-incident review

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Migrating a Hive Warehouse to Iceberg with Spark and Trino Access
subtopics: Inventory and risk classification of source tables
Iceberg conversion plan with validation and rollback
Shared metastore access from Hive, Spark and Trino
Ranger and workload management for the new platform
TPC-DS or replayed-query benchmark before and after
Runbook, cost and cutover decision document
days.lab_task: Starting from a 40-table lab Hive warehouse with ACID, ORC and Parquet tables, migrate it to Iceberg tables using CONVERT TO ICEBERG or CTAS, validate every table with counts, sums and hashes, run 25 replayed queries in Hive, Spark and Trino, apply Ranger masking and a WM plan, and deliver a cutover plan with rollback and a before/after benchmark.
days.deliverable: Migration repository, validation report, benchmark table, Ranger and WM configuration, cutover and rollback plan
checks: Every table shows matching counts and sums or a documented exception
25 replayed queries in Hive, Spark and Trino
Results match and the median latency per engine is tabulated
Original tables are restored with identical counts within the target time
objectives: Deliver an end-to-end Hive to Iceberg migration with validation
Serve the same tables to Hive, Spark and Trino
Present a cutover and rollback decision with data
